name: ThermaSol Nordic Dawn 4-5 Person Outdoor Sauna Cabin
description: Description Unwind and reset with the Nordic Dawn Sauna Cabin, offering relaxation and rejuvenation in a compact yet open-feeling layout. The Nordic Dawn features premium thermo-pine wood construction which extends to the exterior, interior and sauna benches with a beautiful golden-brown finish. The expansive front window features double-glazed glass with argon insulation to bring nature inside while providing a robust thermal barrier for comfortable sauna sessions. The glass properties continue to the outward opening door with a safety latch and optional padlock for added security. Step inside to enjoy the Harvia Spirit's powerful performance while ambient LED lighting provides the perfect wellness escape. Supported by ThermaSol's 1-year warranty, the Nordic Dawn Sauna Cabin delivers quality performance, inviting ambiance, and daily luxury for sauna enthusiasts. Features Thermo-pine construction with a rich golden-brown color that can be left natural or painted. Full-width double-glazed glass window and door with argon insulation acting as a thermal barrier while dampening sound. Durable metal roof built to withstand the outdoor elements year-round. Outward-opening glass door with a safety latch and exterior padlock for safety and security. Integrated LED lighting with control for a soothing ambiance. Arrives fully assembled with pre-wired electrical for turnkey use. Dimensions: 86.8"W (220.5 cm) x 85.4"D (216.9 cm) x 98.8"H (251 cm) Designed and crafted in the U.S.A. What's Included Pre-Assembled Sauna Cabin Harvia Spirit 9kW Electric Heater with Wi-Fi Harvia Xenio CX45 Digital Control with Wi-Fi Harvia R-991 Sauna Stones (4 Boxes) Installation Instructions Specifications Recommended capacity: 4-5 people Exterior (W × D × H): 86.8″ × 85.4″ × 98.8″ Heater: Harvia 9kW SPIRIT Heater with Wi-Fi Sauna type: Traditional (Finnish) Installation: Outdoor, freestanding Lead time: Made to order, 12 weeks (plus 5–10 business days delivery) Shipping & Lead Time Freight is quoted separately for every order based on your delivery location and configuration. After you place your order, our team will contact you with your shipping quote before your build begins. Saunas are delivered fully assembled via flatbed trailer, and you'll be notified roughly two weeks before the scheduled delivery. A forklift or crane is required for placement, and a licensed electrician must connect the heater — manual offloading is not recommended.
